subject: Questions on how to add a header to a dataset

messages.subject: Questions on how to add a header to a dataset
parts:
Hello, all,

I read a large csv file from desktop (called it data), and I have header file as a separate file. Once I want to add header to the dataset, using names(data)<-header, or colnames(data)<-header.

However, the header is not added, it shows logical(0) as the header or V1, V2....

I show my source code:

data<-read.csv("sourcecode.csv",header=F, sep="|")
header<-read.csv("header.csv", header=F,sep="|")
names(data)<-header

Can anyone help me out? Thanks.
